title: 9 Sheet Halloween window clings
text: 9 Sheet Halloween window clings. The price was good, but was disappointed in the fact they look nothing like the photo pictured, do not expect a blue background they are clear with few colors, Amazon folded them in half and stuffed in a Mailer, so now they are creased and won't lay flat.they are small but I guess for the price they're OK.

product_metadata.title: 9 Sheet Halloween Window Clings for Glass, Pumpkin bat Spider Spooky Door Stickers, Halloween Decorations Glass Stickers Wall Decals for Home Party Decoration (139 Pcs)
features: 【9 Sheets in Package】Each halloween window cling sheet measures 11.8 inch × 7.9 inch, includes Pumpkin, Witch, Bats, Castle, Spider web, Scarecrow, etc Halloween elements
【Premium Material】These window clings are made of environmental friendly semi-transparent PVC. Can see the image from both sides of the window

【Easy to Use】 Window stickers do not need to use glue, make sure the surface is clean and smooth, spray a little water on the window to paste it better. Before pasting, please wipe the window clean and not easy to drop

【Wide Range Of Uses】Halloween Window decoration decals For indoor and outdoor decorations. Kitchen refrigerator decals, cabinet doors, smooth tiles, clean wall, mirrors, etc. It helps add more Halloween day atmosphere
【Various Occasions】Window stickers fit for your living room, bedroom, kitchen or hallways, and are suitable for parties decorate, limited to smooth surfaces
